name: hackshop
description: Hosted MCP for planning Muse gadget bodies, finding source-linked hardware reverse-engineering examples, and inspecting exact-model firmware playbooks with explicit evidence and safety boundaries.
transport_notes: Stateless, POST only. No mcp-session-id is issued; GET and DELETE return 405. CORS allows any origin.

tools.name: intake_gadget
tools.description: The 4 intake questions, why they matter and how answers map to plan_gadget.

tools.name: plan_gadget
tools.description: Plan a Muse gadget body from the intake answers: fit, warnings, notes, picks with difficulty and build links.

tools.name: get_build_plan
tools.description: Return difficulty, flash warnings, parts, shopping list, assembly steps with checks, commands and agent brief for a device.

tools.name: assess_hackability
tools.description: Look up catalog hackability, brick risk, firmware links and build support.

tools.name: find_reverse_engineering_examples
tools.description: Search source-linked hardware projects and analysis methods with exact models, evidence, repeatability, risk and checked sources.

tools.name: find_firmware_playbooks
tools.description: Find curated firmware, local-protocol and cloud-replacement paths, preferring the least invasive option.

tools.name: check_firmware_compatibility
tools.description: Fail-closed exact target matching; missing identifiers return unknown and mismatches return unsupported.

tools.name: get_firmware_playbook
tools.description: Return prerequisites, backup, recovery, risks, sources, steps and validation for one playbook.

tools.name: verify_firmware_artifact
tools.description: Compare supplied filename, source and SHA-256 metadata without fetching or uploading a binary.

tools.name: prepare_firmware_job
tools.description: Prepare a non-executing manifest and stop points after owner authorization and a confirmed exact match.
